title: Approval Standards and Determination Period for Patient Hardship Discount Program Applications
content:
**Standard.** A Patient Hardship Discount Program application is approved only after every required document is received or the attestation is on file, within the level's determination time in calendar days, by the level's approver, after a Medicaid screening where the level requires one and after a financial counselor interview where the level requires one. The effective date of an approved determination is the application date, and the expiry date is the level's eligibility period in months later, less one day.

### Conditions of approval

| Condition | When it applies | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Every required document received, or the attestation on file | Every approval | The documents recorded as received against this same application |
| Decision within the determination time | Every approval | Calendar days counted after the application is complete |
| Approved by the level's approver | Every approval | The billing office, or the Business Office Director, as the level sets |
| Medicaid screening completed | Where the level requires a Medicaid screening | — |
| Financial counselor interview completed | Where the level requires an interview | — |

The documents that count are those received for this application. Documents received for another application of the same patient do not complete this one.

### What approval records

An approved determination shows the status *approved*, the level approved, the determination date, the effective date, the expiry date and the approver.

### Determination period

- **Effective date:** the application date.
- **Expiry date:** the application date moved forward by the level's eligibility period in months, less one day.

| Hypothetical application date | Eligibility period | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-16 | 6 months | 2026-09-15 |
| 2026-03-16 | 12 months | 2027-03-15 |

In the first row, six months after 2026-03-16 is 2026-09-16, and one day less gives 2026-09-15. The determination therefore covers 2026-03-16 through 2026-09-15, both days included.

### Points of judgement

- *All documents are in but the level requires an interview that has not taken place.* The application is not yet approved.
- *An attestation of no income is on file in place of income documents.* The document condition is met by the attestation.
